table_of_contents_markers.provenance: Issue 126 plan 10, F1: heading words of a table of contents in each language; the page is read by its first lines; plural variant 'Tables des matieres' as printed by real report R01 (2026-11-25)

figure_list_markers.provenance: Issue 126 plan 10, F1: heading words of the list of figures in each language; variant 'Tables des figures' as printed by real report R01 (2026-11-25)

table_list_markers.provenance: Issue 126 plan 10, F1: heading words of the list of tables in each language

executive_summary_markers.provenance: Issue 126 plan 10, F1: heading words of the executive summary in each language

max_list_words.provenance: proposal 2026-11-25, tune on the counts of the real reports: a list page holds fewer words than a body page

min_entry_lines.provenance: proposal 2026-11-25, tune on the counts of the real reports: entry lines (text ending with a page number) that make a continuation page

heading_max_chars.provenance: proposal 2026-11-25, tune on the counts of the real reports: a heading marker starts within the first 40 characters of the page text (the text layer is joined into one line, so lines cannot mark a heading)

language_mode.provenance: Issue 126 plan 16, N3 (owner, 2026-11-25): no language correction on the cover and the version page, spelling only on the table of contents and the lists, full correction on the summary; a page absent from this map is body and is judged in full

figure_entry_words.provenance: Issue 126 plan 5, E1: the word that opens a printed figure entry in each language

table_entry_words.provenance: Issue 126 plan 5, E1: the word that opens a printed table entry in each language

entry_number_pattern.provenance: Issue 126 plan 5, E1 and N2: a printed number kept as a string (12, 2.1, A.1); a dot after it ends the number

appendix_markers.provenance: Issue 126 plan 15, N4 (owner, 2026-11-25): the word that opens an appendix heading or a contents entry; an id after it is a capital letter, a roman numeral or a number

dot_leader_pattern.provenance: Issue 126 review round 1 (M3): a dot leader followed by a page number ends a contents entry; was a literal in front_pages.py

entry_start_pattern.provenance: Issue 126 review round 1 (I2): a page whose text opens with an entry (a word, then its printed number) continues the list whatever its count
